## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Restore `--wait` before merge: this PR deletes the option outright, so existing invocations now fail instead of getting the deprecated alias that the PR's own ADR describes.

## Changes
The PR renames the CLI's `--wait` option to `--timeout` in `app/cli.py`, updates `tests/test_cli.py` to use the new name, adds ADR `docs/adr/007-timeout.md` for the change, and adds a one-line `review.txt` at the repository root.

## Critical
- app/cli.py:6 — correctness — Keep `--wait` as a deprecated alias for `--timeout` — `parse_args(["--wait", "12"])` now exits with argparse usage error code 2 because only `--timeout` is registered. ADR line 5 says: "Accept `--wait` as an alias for one release and emit a deprecation warning when it is used." — Existing scripts that pass `--wait` stop working with no deprecation period, which goes against the decision this PR records. — Fix: Add `"--wait"` as a second option string that sets `dest="timeout"` and emits a `DeprecationWarning` when used, and add `--wait` cases to `test_explicit_options`.
